int_name: N FRONT ST & E VENANGO ST

result.summary: The street environment is characterized by an industrial setting with sidewalks but a complete lack of pedestrian crossing infrastructure. The wide, unmarked roadway and parked vehicles create significant sightline issues and offer no protected space for pedestrians to cross.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crossings
hazards.description: There are no designated or marked areas for pedestrians to cross the street safely.

hazards.name: Visual obstructions from parked cars
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the left curb block sight lines between drivers and pedestrians attempting to cross.

hazards.name: Unmarked wide roadway
hazards.description: The absence of lane markings can lead to higher vehicle speeds and unpredictable lane positioning.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install marked crosswalks with high-visibility patterns to designate safe crossing points.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Add curb extensions (bulb-outs) at potential crossing points to reduce crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Lane Markings and Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Paint clear lane markings and implement traffic calming measures like speed humps to manage vehicle speeds.

result.summary: The environment is an industrial or commercial area with wide, unmarked roadways that prioritize vehicle movement. While sidewalks are present, the intersection lacks marked crosswalks, pedestrian signals, and ADA-compliant curb ramps, creating a hostile environment for people walking.

hazards.name: Unmarked crosswalks
hazards.description: There are no painted markings to designate a pedestrian crossing area at this signalized intersection.

hazards.name: Lack of pedestrian signals
hazards.description: The intersection has traffic lights for vehicles but lacks dedicated signals for pedestrians to safely time their crossing.
hazards.location_in_image: Traffic light pole on the left

hazards.name: Wide crossing distance
hazards.description: The wide, unmarked pavement increases the time pedestrians are exposed to traffic without any refuge.

interventions.title: High-visibility crosswalks
interventions.description: Install zebra-striped crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way and increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: Pedestrian countdown signals
interventions.description: Install countdown pedestrian signals to provide clear crossing intervals and improve safety at the signalized intersection.

interventions.title: Curb extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to reduce crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The intersection lacks basic pedestrian infrastructure such as marked crosswalks and dedicated pedestrian signals despite the presence of vehicular traffic lights. The wide, unmarked roadway and narrow sidewalks adjacent to commercial buildings create a hostile environment for walking.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks at this signalized intersection, leaving pedestrians without a designated or protected path.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No pedestrian-specific signal heads are visible, forcing pedestrians to interpret vehicular signals which may not provide enough clearance time.
hazards.location_in_image: On the utility and signal poles at the corners

hazards.name: Wide Unmarked Roadway
hazards.description: The excessive width of the unmarked pavement can encourage higher vehicle speeds and increases the time pedestrians are exposed to traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Main roadway stretching into the background

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install ladder or zebra-style crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian space and alert drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing information.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at the corners to reduce the crossing distance and improve sight lines between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The environment is characterized by a lack of basic pedestrian infrastructure at a signalized intersection, including missing crosswalk markings and pedestrian signals. The existing sidewalk on the right is severely degraded and overgrown, creating significant accessibility and safety barriers.

hazards.name: Degraded Sidewalk
hazards.description: The sidewalk on the right side of the image is severely cracked, uneven, and overgrown with vegetation, creating a trip hazard and making it impassable for those with mobility aids.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: Despite the presence of a traffic signal, there are no painted crosswalks, leaving pedestrians without a designated or protected path across the wide intersection.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: The intersection lacks pedestrian-specific signal heads, forcing pedestrians to rely on vehicular signals which may not provide adequate clearance time.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks on all legs of the intersection to define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Reconstruction
interventions.description: Repair and level the sidewalk on the right side to provide a continuous, ADA-compliant walking surface.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Signal Heads
interventions.description: Install countdown pedestrian signals to provide clear information on when it is safe to cross.

interventions.title: Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install ADA-compliant curb ramps with detectable warning surfaces at all crossing points.
